title: The Bank Deposit On-Time Promise
content:
Paloma's on-time promise on Bank Deposit concerns a transfer that reaches the recipient after its disclosed date of availability. Whether a tier carries the promise is a tier term.

## Clauses in force

1. **Transfer fee only.** The promise covers the transfer fee only; card funding fees and surcharges are not part of it.
2. **No error notice needed.** A customer may claim it from an agent without giving an error notice.
3. **Once per transfer.** The transfer fee is refunded at most once on a transfer, so the on-time refund and an error-resolution fee refund never stack.
4. **Tiers without the promise.** A tier whose terms do not carry the on-time promise gives no automatic fee refund for lateness, and the customer's route is an error notice.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following two clauses are **no longer in force**. Each is superseded by the current basis for the on-time promise refund and is kept here only as retired text.

> ~~On a tier carrying the on-time promise, Paloma refunds the transfer fee in full, with the refund reason "late delivery", when the transfer was deposited after its date of availability as last disclosed.~~

> ~~The promise does not apply when the lateness came from the customer: wrong beneficiary details the customer supplied, or a request for information the customer answered after the answer period.~~

## Points of judgement on the clauses in force

- **A credit card funding fee on a late transfer.** Not covered by the promise, which concerns the transfer fee only.
- **The customer has not filed an error notice.** The promise may still be claimed from an agent.
- **The transfer fee was already refunded once on this transfer.** It is not refunded a second time, whichever rule the first refund came under.
- **A late Bank Deposit International Wire transfer.** That tier does not carry the promise; the customer's route is an error notice.

superseded_clauses: On a tier whose on_time_promise is true, Paloma refunds the transfer fee in full, with fee_refund_reason late_delivery, when the transfer was deposited after its date_available as last disclosed.
The promise does not apply when the lateness came from the customer: wrong beneficiary details the customer supplied, or a request for information the customer answered after rfi_response_days.
